comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This quest also unlocks an unlisted 7* biology quest from San Francisco's Adventure Mediator:

Dancing Face
R8 Ecological Research, R10 Biology, Oceania language skill (as usual, not needed since Body Language works fine)

Step 1: Talk to Young Man (Samarai)
Step 2: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast LP. Go to the Swamp and use Observe/Perception of Artisan, E.Research; target is "East 85 m North 34 m" from Swamp landmark.
